scope: Canonical SmartGlasses audience video reused across the owned app and channel adapters
authority: Human creative preference; no change to financial, source-rights or publishing authority.

reference.use: Visual and pacing reference only. Reassess claims, media rights and old wording before reuse.
reference.missing_reference: Report the missing reference; do not silently substitute a different creative style.

atomic_content.rule: One buyer question, one primary attribute or comparison concept, one canonical video. Evidence caveats and attribution do not create extra topics.

visuals.direction: Vivid, colourful, realistic imagery with energetic kinetic typography.
visuals.imagery: Original or appropriately licensed imagery. Concept imagery must not imply verified product appearance or capabilities.
visuals.abstract_only: Technical preview fallback only; not the audience-facing default.

audio.background_music: Required for the normal audience-facing creative profile; original or appropriately licensed.
audio.voiceover: Off by default. Narration and background music are independent settings.
audio.rights: Record provenance and intended channel/commercial-use rights; do not assume any available track is cleared.

editorial.presentation: Use concise hooks and readable copy. Keep decision-critical caveats visible and fuller evidence readily accessible.
editorial.prohibited: Do not invent hands-on experience, product performance, source clearance, guaranteed views or revenue.

story_quality.opening_rule: Earn attention in the first 1-8 seconds with an audience tension or consequential question; do not open with a logo, product name or generic category introduction.
story_quality.differentiator_rule: Use one decision-relevant, source-bound difference, trade-off, change or insight. If no such lever exists, do not manufacture one; return the brief for more evidence or a different angle.
story_quality.proof_rule: Put the source-bound assertion next to the differentiator and preserve material conditions, uncertainty and comparison basis.
story_quality.payoff_rule: End with a memorable decision, question or next action that resolves the opening tension instead of repeating a generic evidence disclaimer.
story_quality.visual_progression: Each primitive must perform a distinct narrative job. Repeated imagery or motion requires a deliberate semantic reason.

feedback_disposition.creative_regression: The plain, silent comparison/product/feature exports are technical drafts, not accepted creative baselines.
feedback_disposition.architecture_regression: Video demos and passing local tests do not establish a functioning warehouse, agent runtime or feedback-learning loop.

proposed_acceptance_checks: Audio inspection confirms a background-music stream independently of narration.
Required image assets and rights metadata are available.
The output follows the preferred vivid image-led reference rather than a plain-card fallback.
The active profile revision is stored in the storyboard and render manifest.
A creative-preference change identifies affected outputs for rework.
